mapper.sql: note.Tn_Date, REPLACE(CONVERT(char(10), note.Tn_Date, 120), '-', '.') AS tnDateStr, note.Tn_Flag, note.Tn_Aflag, note.Tn_Seq, note.Tn_Time, note.Tn_Title, note.Tn_UK, note.Tn_UserID, insa.Ic_Name, dbo.GetBuserNm(insa.Ic_Buser) AS buserNm, note.Tn_Seflag, note.Tn_TOP, note.Tn_ImgNum, CONCAT(note.Tn_Flag, CONVERT(CHAR(8), note.Tn_Date, 112), note.Tn_AFlag, note.Tn_Seq) AS tvUk, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM I_TotalNoteView WHERE Tv_UK = CONCAT(note.Tn_Flag, CONVERT(CHAR(8), note.Tn_Date, 112), note.Tn_AFlag, note.Tn_Seq)) AS viewCount, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM I_TotalNoteView WHERE Tv_SaCd = #{searchId} AND Tv_UK = CONCAT(note.Tn_Flag, CONVERT(CHAR(8), note.Tn_Date, 112), note.Tn_AFlag, note.Tn_Seq) ) OR note.Tn_Date < CASE WHEN insa.Ic_Indate < '2013-03-01' THEN '2013-03-01' ELSE insa.Ic_Indate END THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS ccView
FROM I_TotalNote note LEFT JOIN P_InsaCode insa ON note.Tn_UserID = insa.Ic_Code

WHERE
note.Tn_Flag BETWEEN 3 AND 5
note.Tn_Flag = #{tnFlag}
AND note.Tn_DelFlag NOT IN (0) AND note.Tn_Date >= #{searchFromDate} AND note.Tn_Date < DATEADD(DAY, 1, CONVERT(date, #{searchToDate}))
AND note.Tn_Seflag = #{tnSeflag}
AND (UPPER(note.Tn_Title) LIKE '%' + UPPER(#{searchKeyword}) + '%' OR UPPER(CONVERT(nvarchar(max), note.Tn_Remark)) LIKE '%' + UPPER(#{searchKeyword}) + '%')
AND UPPER(CONVERT(nvarchar(max), note.Tn_Remark)) LIKE '%' + UPPER(#{searchKeyword}) + '%'
AND (UPPER(insa.Ic_Name) LIKE '%' + UPPER(#{searchKeyword}) + '%' OR UPPER(note.Tn_UK) LIKE '%' + UPPER(#{searchKeyword}) + '%')
AND UPPER(note.Tn_Title) LIKE '%' + UPPER(#{searchKeyword}) + '%'
mapper.select:
SELECT
ORDER BY note.Tn_Date DESC, note.Tn_Time DESC, note.Tn_Seq DESC, note.Tn_Aflag DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
